resources.string: You aren\'t still in bed, right?
Tap here and complete the Wake Up Check or your alarm will start ringing again.
An alarm can\'t be edited during the Wake Up Check
While this is on, Alarme cannot be uninstalled — not even mid-alarm. Turn it off in Alarme settings to uninstall.
Lets Alarme pull the ring screen back to the front when you try to turn the phone off or leave the alarm. Alarme only checks which app is in front; it never reads screen content.
